# Browser renderer notices

The SO-101 trajectory lab vendors the following browser libraries so the local
simulator continues to work without Node.js or internet access:

- Three.js 0.180.0, MIT License. The upstream license text is included at
  `three/LICENSE`.
- `urdf-loader` 0.12.6 by Gavin S. P. II and contributors, Apache License 2.0.
  Source: <https://github.com/gkjohnson/urdf-loaders/tree/v0.12.6>
  License: <https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0>

The SO-101 URDF and STL files are fetched separately from LeRobot's
`robot-urdfs/so101` bucket and are not copied into this source tree.
